name: Wake up
location: Cozy pastel treehouse bedroom, warm wooden walls, round window
camera: Open on a slow push-in close on sleeping Mipo (hook in first second: sunbeam sparkles + yawn), ease out to medium-wide as he hops out of bed, end with slight push toward the window.

name: The wand and the trail
location: Treehouse porch with wooden railing overlooking the magical valley
camera: Medium shot of Mipo on the porch, valley behind him; slow push-in; slight rack focus to the sparkle trail at the end.

name: Across the bridge
location: Arched stone bridge over a sparkling river
camera: Side-on tracking shot following Mipo left to right across the bridge; slight parallax; ends medium two-shot with the bird.

name: Friends find the color
location: Flower meadow near the giant treehouse tree, purple crystals (grey for now)
camera: Medium-wide group shot, gentle push toward the flower.

name: One little tap
location: Same meadow, closer framing, then reveal of the sky
camera: Clip A (20.0-22.6): medium close-up framing Mipo, the flower, the bunny AND the full baby deer. Clip B (22.6-25.0): smooth tilt-up / pull-back from the flower to the sky as the purple stripe paints back into the rainbow.

name: Hooray!
location: Meadow under the complete rainbow, full color
camera: Wide-to-medium celebratory shot, gentle settle; Mipo center, looking into camera for the wave; top 25% of frame kept clear for the end card.
